In this video, we take a detailed on-ground look at the massive expansion of S.C.B. Medical College & Hospital, Cuttack — one of the most important government medical institutions in Odisha & Eastern India.
As per official reports and reputed news sources, SCB Medical College & Hospital is being upgraded to AIIMS++ standards with an investment of over ₹4,400 crore.
After completion of the first phase, the hospital’s bed capacity is expected
to increase to around 3,796 beds, with a long-term vision of developing a
5000-bed integrated medical facility.
